subject: business-studies

moments.title: Owen takes over New Lanark
moments.body: Owen runs New Lanark cotton mills with shorter hours, infant schools and worker housing while remaining profitable.
moments.takeaway: Profit and welfare can coexist with deliberate management design.

moments.title: New Harmony, Indiana
moments.body: Owen's utopian community fails within three years but inspires the cooperative movement.
moments.takeaway: Utopian experiments often inform later reforms even when they fail.

moments.title: Rochdale Pioneers
moments.body: Rochdale codifies cooperative principles that spread globally to retail, banking and platforms.
moments.takeaway: Owen's legacy lives in the cooperative movement.

now.title: Social enterprise today
now.body: B-Corps, social enterprises and ESG frameworks revive the Owenite combination of welfare and profit.
now.open_questions: Can social enterprise scale to dominant sectors of the economy?

reflection: Owen's mix of philanthropy, business and utopianism prefigures contemporary social enterprise.
